notes: HKEX MSCI China A 50 Connect (USD) Index Futures daily market report zips (mcaf{YYMMDD}.zip day+settlement+OI, mcafa{YYMMDD}.zip after-hours of that trading date). Static files behind Akamai but bot-lenient for plain GETs (2026-10-26 probes); 404 is a legitimate per-date miss (non-trading day / report not yet final / beyond the ~1y archive retention), and the tracker only blocks on 403/429. The product-page widget API (www1.hkex.com.hk/hkexwidget/data/getchartdata2) is IP/session-token gated and only serves ~1 month of per-contract daily bars, hence this report-zip source.
